physicalNotes: Radius 0.2108131 Jupiter radii from Barragán et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.522.3458B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.3458B/abstract): 15,071.5 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.03240742 Jupiter masses (Barragán et al. 2023, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2023MNRAS.522.3458B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.3458B/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
